name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Electric/Grass Counters
archetype: High physical defense, Water/Grass Regenerator pivots, and Electric/Psychic speed sweepers.
gym_duel_rationale: Misty enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Enter the arena with Wartortle/Tangela (monstrous 103 Defense Water/Grass pivot taking 0.25x resistance from Water moves while draining health with Mega Drain) and Kadabra/Pikachu (Base 95 Speed special sweeper with super-effective Electro Ball and 100% Thunder Wave paralysis).

roster.progression_notes: Fusing Wartortle (evolved Lv. 16) with Route 1 Tangela yields a towering 103 Base Defense and 76 Special Attack. Completely walls Misty's Water Pulse with 4x quad-resistance.
Fusing Kadabra with Viridian Forest Pikachu produces 95 Base Speed and 96 Special Attack. Super-effective Electro Ball shreds Misty's Water Pokémon.
Defiant physical attacker for general route progression, caves, and rival clearing.
Compound Eyes Sleep Powder guarantees easy wild catches when hunting rare spawns.

flex_bench.why_use: Mt. Moon Geodude spliced with Poliwag gains Water Absorb, removing Water weakness while maintaining high physical defense.
Mt. Moon Clefairy with Magic Guard ignores entry hazard damage, poison ticks, and weather chip.

active_fusions: Wartortle/Tangela (Water/Grass starter wall quad-resisting Water with Mega Drain)
Kadabra/Pikachu (95 Spe Psychic/Electric special sweeper with Electro Ball)
Mankey/Spearow (Fighting/Flying physical cleaner with Low Kick)
Butterfree/Beedrill (Bug/Poison wild capture utility with 97.5% Sleep Powder)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Purchase Super Splicers at Cerulean Poké Mart ($300 at any Mart).
2. Evolve Squirtle to Wartortle (Lv. 16) and splice with Route 1 Tangela for 103 Base Defense and 4x Water resistance.
3. Splice Route 24 Kadabra with Viridian Forest Pikachu for high-speed Electric coverage.
4. Retain Butterfree/Beedrill from Chapter 1 for easy wild catches on Routes 4, 24, and 25.
upcoming_fusions: Wartortle/Geodude (Chapter 3 Vermilion City starter splice for 100% Electric immunity against Surge)
